analysis: The closest option gives sustained coverage of software, algorithms, systems and mathematical methods. Python, discrete mathematics and data structures precede advanced algorithms and software development in C++ and Haskell. Database design and networking and operating systems address essential systems content. Numerical methods, linear systems, multivariable calculus and probability support machine learning, optimisation and decision modelling. Introductory computer vision fits after Python. The planned offerings require advanced algorithms in spring 2028 and optimisation in spring 2029. Removing generic philosophy and generic ethics makes room for technically relevant calculus and signals. Research Methods & Statistics supports research design and evaluation. Product Design and rhetorical communication are complementary skills and make no disciplinary equivalence claim.

Robotics and reinforcement learning have substantial computational content. They could support a computing composition, but have fewer links to the required core than advanced algorithms, software, databases, operating systems or calculus. The closest option already includes machine learning, deep learning, decisions under uncertainty and optimisation. A separate AI and data option would share the essential technical foundations and make changes mainly among applied or supporting courses. There is no independently grounded additional option from the 12 direct interests. Security and architecture are core interests with incomplete UCR coverage, not bases for a second schedule.

One row pairs Networks & Operating Systems with the operating-systems course because its process, memory and storage coverage is direct. The same UCR course cannot supply a second separate match for Computer Networks. Software Development contributes C++ and Haskell, design, testing and maintenance. The separate functional and advanced programming units remain visible. Visual recognition pipelines do not teach graphics rendering, and iterative product design does not survey computing science. Advanced Calculus is a better match to Calculus 2 than Numerical Methods. The dedicated security, distributed systems, web engineering and research components have separate rows. The optional UCR research element is outside the fixed 180 EC.
constructionStop: One independently grounded closest response. The direct interests belong to it and the broader topics do not generate a distinct additional curriculum.
